item.title: I-71 rest areas to be converted into semi truck parking facilities in $6.8 million project by Ohio DOT
item.description: The Ohio Department of Transportation (ODOT) will soon shutter a pair of rest areas along I-71 in order to convert them into truck parking facilities.
